questions.stem: Why do proximal convoluted tubule cells have many mitochondria?

options.text: To provide energy for active transport of useful substances
To break down waste products in the filtrate
To produce water for diluting the urine

questions.explanation: The many mitochondria in PCT cells carry out aerobic respiration to release energy (ATP). This energy is needed for the active transport of glucose, amino acids, and mineral ions from the filtrate back into the blood.
